profile.subtitleJa: 人を惑わす存在として言及される
profile.summaryJa: ペトロはアナニアに、サタンがその心を満たしたと語ります。

facts.textJa: パウロは召命の言葉を引用し、人々をサタンの支配から神に立ち返らせる働きを述べます。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: But Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back part of the price of the land?

to open their eyes, that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive remission of sins and an inheritance among those who are sanctified by faith in me.’
